charter_messages.name: Rtr. Bibek Bhattarai
message: It is with immense pride and joy that I welcome you to the Rotaract Club of Tribhuvan University. When we chartered this club on 29 August 2023, my vision was to establish a vibrant platform where young minds could come together to serve, learn, and grow. I strongly believe that Rotaract is not just about volunteering — it is about shaping ourselves into better leaders, professionals, and citizens through service and fellowship.

Our guiding vision has always been "to be a dynamic university-based service organization, dedicated to professional development while fostering fellowship, and uplifting members through impactful initiatives". This vision continues to inspire our members as we take small but meaningful steps toward creating lasting change within our university and our community.

As we move forward, I encourage every member to embrace opportunities, lead with passion, and embody the spirit of "Service Above Self". Together with our parent club, the Rotary Club of Kirtipur, we will continue building a culture of service, leadership, and global connection for the betterment of society.

charter_messages.name: Rtr. Dinesh Gaire
message:
Dear Rotaractors of Tribhuvan University,
Blissful Rota Greetings!

It is truly inspiring to witness the dedication and creativity of your club as you work toward launching your official website for RY 2025–26. This initiative reflects your commitment to growth, transparency, and stronger engagement within the Rotaract community.

As you embark on new projects and ideas this year, I encourage you to continue exploring your strengths, fostering collaboration, and embracing innovation. Together, let us move forward with purpose and passion, Unleashing Infinite Potential in everything we do.
Wishing the entire team a productive and impactful year ahead.

charter_messages.name: Rtr. Nikhil Acharya
message:
Dear Rotaractors of Tribhuvan University,
Warm Rota Greetings!

It gives me immense joy and pride to write to you today as your Zone Representative. As I reflect upon your journey, I would like to extend my heartfelt congratulations to the entire club for the remarkable progress you have made in such a short span of time since your charter on 29th August 2023. Your growth has not only been impressive but also deeply inspiring, demonstrating what a motivated and united group of young leaders can achieve when driven by purpose and passion.

From the very beginning, your club has shown exceptional promise. In less than two years, you have carved out a distinct identity within the district, an identity built on consistency, proactiveness, and a strong sense of service. Whether through your participation, your initiatives, or your presence in zonal and district activities, the Rotaract Club of Tribhuvan University has stood out as a club that is steadily rising and influencing the Rotaract movement in meaningful ways.

One of the greatest strengths of your club is undoubtedly your active and engaged members. Each member brings something unique to the table, and together, you have created an environment where leadership is not limited to positions, it thrives in actions, ideas, and willingness to serve. I have observed that many of you are not just participants but leaders in your own right, stepping up, taking ownership, and representing your club with confidence and sincerity. Clubs are built on people, and your people are truly your biggest asset.

I would also like to take a moment to appreciate your President, whose leadership has been exemplary. Leading a young and growing club requires patience, clarity, and emotional intelligence, and your President embodies all these qualities with remarkable balance. The calm and collected way in which challenges are handled, the empathy shown towards members, and the ability to lead with love rather than authority has created a culture of trust and harmony within the club. Such leadership is rare, and it plays a significant role in shaping the direction of a Rotaract club, especially one as young as yours.

As a ZRR, I am genuinely excited about the potential your club holds. With your strong foundation, committed members, and compassionate leadership, I am confident that the Rotaract Club of Tribhuvan University will continue to grow, evolve, and shine even brighter in the years to come. Your journey has just begun, and the path ahead is filled with opportunities to make an even greater impact within your campus, your community, and the entire Rotaract fraternity.
I wish you continued success, unending enthusiasm, and many more milestones in the days ahead. Please know that I am always here to support you, guide you, and celebrate your achievements.

charter_messages.name: Rtn. Lok Raj Koirala
message:
Dear Rotaractors of Tribhuvan University,
Warm Greetings!

It is with great joy and pride that I extend my warmest greetings to the members of the Rotaract Club of Tribhuvan University. Your consistent dedication, innovative spirit, and proactive involvement in service have always made you an inspiring part of our Rotary family. As the Parent Club, the Rotary Club of Kirtipur deeply values your energy, enthusiasm, and commitment to creating positive change.

Rotaract represents the future of Rotary—young leaders who are passionate about service, professional growth, and community development. Over the years, your club has demonstrated remarkable leadership, thoughtful initiatives, and meaningful contributions that reflect the true essence of "Service Above Self." Your academic environment, combined with your social awareness, positions you uniquely to address community needs with creativity and empathy.

As you embark on RY 2025–26, I encourage each member to continue embracing teamwork, innovation, and compassion. Let this year be one of bold ideas, impactful projects, and stronger collaboration between our two clubs. Always remember that the strength of Rotaract lies not only in the projects you undertake but also in the friendships you build, the values you uphold, and the growth you experience along the way.

The Rotary Club of Kirtipur stands beside you with full support, guidance, and encouragement. Together, we can create a lasting impact in our community and inspire others through our shared commitment to service.
I wish President Rtr. Dipak Dhakal and the entire team a successful, productive, and fulfilling Rotaract year. May your efforts continue to shine and set an example for others to follow.

charter_messages.name: Rtr. Suman Mainali
message:
Dear Rotaractors of Tribhuvan University,
Warm Rotaract Greetings!

It is with immense happiness and deep respect that I write to you today as the President of the Rotaract Club of Kirtipur for RY 2025–26. As your sister club, we have always admired your growth, your enthusiasm, and the spirit of leadership that each member of the Rotaract Club of Tribhuvan University carries with pride.

Since your charter, your club has consistently demonstrated what committed young leaders can achieve when guided by purpose, unity, and compassion. Your presence in community service, your active involvement in district events, and your ability to uplift the Rotaract spirit have truly set you apart as one of the most promising and inspiring clubs in our Rotaract family.

What stands out most about your club is the collective strength of your members—individuals who are proactive, talented, and dedicated to creating meaningful impact. You are a team that leads through action, collaborates with openness, and embraces every challenge with determination. This shared mindset is what makes your club a shining example of what Rotaract can accomplish.

I would also like to extend my heartfelt appreciation to your President, Rtr. Dipak Dhakal. His calm leadership, thoughtful approach, and encouragement toward his team have helped build a culture of trust, respect, and togetherness within your club. His ability to guide with empathy and vision reflects the true essence of Rotaract leadership.

As we move forward into RY 2025–26, I want you to know that the Rotaract Club of Kirtipur stands beside you—with full support, shared dreams, and a strong commitment to collaborative growth. Together, we can bring even more impactful projects to life, strengthen our bond as sister clubs, and serve our communities with greater purpose and compassion.

I wish your President, your board, and every member of the Rotaract Club of Tribhuvan University a successful, fulfilling, and inspiring Rotaract year ahead. May your ideas flourish, your leadership grow, and your contributions continue to shine brightly throughout the Rotaract movement.

themes.title: Presidential Theme – RY 2026/27: DREAM. JOIN. PERFORM.
themes.description:
This theme carries a dual purpose: To uplift our communities and to elevate every single member of RAC TU.

DREAM : Of a better society, and of becoming the best versions of ourselves.

JOIN : Unite with like-minded change-makers not just to serve together, but to network, learn, and grow together.

PERFORM : Execute with excellence. Deliver social impact while sharpening our leadership, communication, and professional skills.

At RAC TU, we don't just change lives out there, we change our own lives right here. We grow as we give. Let's transform society and ourselves. Let's make this year unforgettable.

themes.title: Rotaract District Theme: Integrity, Vision, and Leadership
themes.description:
The Rotaract District 3292 theme represents a powerful triptych of core values: Integrity, Vision, and Leadership. Visually, the emblem captures this spirit through an abstract, dynamic human figure colored in striking gradients of deep pink and blue, reaching upward toward a glowing golden star. Flanked by stylized individuals waving flags, the design symbolizes collective action, youthful energy, and a shared community purpose. It serves as a visual reminder that true leadership within the district is not solitary, but rather a collaborative journey fueled by ambition and grounded in ethical values.

Beneath this artistic representation lies a strategic call to action for all Rotaractors within the district. Integrity establishes the moral compass for every community service and professional development initiative, ensuring transparency and deep-rooted respect. Vision challenges clubs to look beyond immediate fixes, encouraging them to design sustainable, long-term solutions for local and global needs. Finally, Leadership acts as the catalyst, empowering young professionals to take ownership of their projects, inspire their peers, and drive meaningful, progressive change across their communities.
